A silver Roman Republican coin; a denarius issued by Mn. Cordius Rufus. It was minted in Rome in 46BC, Reece period 1. The obverse shows the Head of Venus right, wearing a diadem. The obverse legend reads RVFVS.S.[C] retrograde . The reverse shows Cupid riding a dolphin facing right; bankers marks. The reverse legend is almost illegible but seems to read MCO[...].
